```{r}
sim_out <- readRDS("data/simulated_assignments_with_meta.rds")
sim_out$metadata

```


```{r}
fit_sim <- function(
  fit_fun_sim
  , nboot = 200
  , nrep = 200
  , keep = c("i", "year", "start_year", "start_year_sim"
    , "urb", "y", "n", "y0_hat", paste0("y0_post_", 1:nboot)
  )
  , mc_cores = 18
  , worlds = 1:3
  , file_name = NULL
  , ...
) {
  for (k in worlds) {
    start_all <- Sys.time()
    result <- mclapply(1:nrep, \(r) {
      dt |> set_y0(A_sim = sim_a[, r, k])
      #is_test_set <- is.na(dt$y0) & dt$year < dt$start_year
      #sum(is_test_set)
      dt |> fit_fun_sim(nboot = nboot, ...)
      pre <- dt$year < dt$start_year # we only ave pre-treatment
      dt[pre, ..keep]
    }, mc.cores = mc_cores) |>
      rbindlist(idcol = "r")
    end_all <- Sys.time()
    print(end_all - start_all)
    saveRDS(result, paste0("data/new_imputation_"
      , file_name, "_", k, ".rds"
    ))
  }
}
```

```{r}
fit_sim(fit_fun_sim = impute_xgb
  , nrep = 200, mc_cores = 18
  , worlds = 1:3, nboot = 200
  , file_name = "xgb"
)
```

```{r}
fm_etwfe <- formula(y0 ~ 1 | start_year + year)

  , nrep = 200, mc_cores = 18, fm = fm_twfe
  , worlds = 1:3, nboot = 200
  , file_name = "twfe"
)
```
